# ABK Trading & Service

> Car care shop, paint protection film (PPF) installer and wholesale
> distributor in Mesaimeer, Doha, Qatar. Retail store + installation workshop
> for Vertek PPF and window tint, Autotriz ceramic coatings and polishing
> compounds, Briller and Insta Finish car shampoos and detailing chemicals,
> Getsun aerosols, and ABK home and car fragrances. Wholesale supply to
> detailing shops, car washes and body shops across Qatar and the GCC.

## Business facts

- Name: ABK Trading & Service (Google Business Profile: "ABK Trading and Service — Vertek & Autotriz", category: car accessories store)
- Address: Shop 2 & 3, Building 1306, Street 70, Zone 56, Mesaimeer, Doha, Qatar
- Coordinates: 25.2040478, 51.5029268 — map: https://maps.google.com/?cid=9860894303806767987
- Phone / WhatsApp: +974 30838355 — Email: sales@abktradingservice.com
- Hours: Saturday–Thursday 10:00–13:00 and 16:00–22:00; Friday closed
- Languages: English and Arabic (every page exists at /en/… and /ar/…)
- Area served: Doha, Al Rayyan, Al Wakrah, Al Wukair, Lusail, Umm Salal, Al Khor and the rest of Qatar; wholesale across the GCC (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman)
- Pricing: quoted per enquiry on WhatsApp — product pages carry no public prices

## What ABK sells

- Brands: Vertek (PPF, window tint), Autotriz (ceramic coatings, compounds, polishes), Briller (car shampoo, wash & wax), Insta Finish (detailing chemicals), Getsun (aerosols), Sitrett, Smart Car, ABK (home and car fragrances)
- Categories: paint protection film, window tint, ceramic coating, car shampoo, polish and compounds, tyre care, glass cleaners, dressings, waxes, interior care, degreasers, heavy-duty cleaners, fragrances, accessories

## Workshop services (Mesaimeer, Doha)

- Vertek PPF installation — full body, front end or custom panels
- Window tinting with Vertek films in Qatar-legal VLT grades
- Autotriz ceramic coating application
- Paint correction and detailing
